versions.changelog:
- Initial release of docx-to-html skill.
- Converts DOCX documents to clean, semantic HTML using mammoth.js.
- Includes both a Node.js converter script and a Python wrapper for easy integration.
- Supports extracting headings, tables, lists, inline formatting, and images from DOCX files.
- Enables use-cases like browser viewing, content extraction for AI, and web integration.
- Includes troubleshooting guidance and outlines current limitations.
